description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uduwawala, Harispaththuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320319 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
